findings.title: Inherited Compose descendants prevent explicit Bépo terminal from completing
findings.confidence: high for fingerprinted genuine native component and locale; desktop/application unmeasured
findings.expected: Bépo cedille in monnaie state completes ₢ after dead_currency/dead_cedilla
findings.observed: Generated rule exists/conflicts0; actual native status remains COMPOSING after pair; following c yields inherited ₵
findings.root: Standard trigger reuse plus unconditional locale include imports longer descendants that shadow explicit shorter terminal; both converter implementations share construction.
findings.silent_failure: Both converters report zero conflicts and generated text includes expected rule; native parser accepts table, but expected output never completes at pair.
findings.regression: Actual native Compose with inherited locale descendants: assert COMPOSED and ₢ after pair; preserve ordinary locale and no-include/private-trigger positive controls.
findings.deduplication: One root across Python/Lua and two inherited C/c descendants; excludes eight known magic contexts and DKL001 runtime consumption root.
findings.qualification: Original converters and genuine installed libxkbcommon table state only; no evdev/desktop/nativeMac/AHK/receiving app.
